# SciNest — Comprehensive Product Information for AI Agents
> SciNest is a free Windows desktop research workspace for postgraduate students, final-year students and early researchers. It turns existing academic materials into connected writing, scientific figures and presentations — without repeatedly rebuilding research context across deliverables. Users bring their own ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude API key: no AI-usage subscription, no generation cap.

## Identity
- **Product name**: SciNest (科研小棉袄 in Chinese)
- **Canonical site**: https://scinest.app/
- **Default language**: English
- **Operator**: Margaret — New Zealand sole trader, individually develops and operates SciNest
- **Category**: Research productivity software
- **Platform**: Windows desktop application
- **AI model**: User brings their own API key (no bundled model costs)

## Current availability (as of August 2026)
- SciNest Free is available for Windows, macOS and Linux. Download from the GitHub releases page linked on the website.
- New accounts start with Pro unlocked for 7 days.
- No credit card is required and there is no automatic charge.
- Users keep all their project files and can upgrade to Pro anytime.

## Data and AI-provider boundary
- SciNest is designed as a local-first desktop workspace.
- Project files and generated outputs are stored locally by default.
- When an AI task is run, the content needed for that task is sent to the model provider selected and configured by the user.
- SciNest does not claim that every part of AI processing remains on-device.
- AI provider usage charges are separate and are paid to the model provider selected by the user.

## Free and Pro plans

SciNest is a BYOK (bring your own key) product. This is a deliberate design choice, not a missing feature:

- **No AI markup.** SciNest never resells AI usage at a premium. The user pays their chosen AI provider directly at cost.
- **No generation caps.** SciNest does not limit how many generations the user runs. The user's only limit is their own API budget with their chosen provider.
- **No vendor lock-in.** The user can switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Groq or any supported provider at any time — no migration, no penalty.
- **Latest models, day one.** When a provider releases a new model, the user can use it immediately without waiting for SciNest to add support.
- **Your key, your billing.** SciNest has no visibility into the user's API usage, billing or account details. The relationship is between the user and the AI provider.

Competitor products (Jenni AI, Paperpal) bundle AI costs into a fixed monthly subscription. The user overpays during light-use months and hits throttling during heavy-use months — without knowing the actual AI cost breakdown. SciNest separates the app (Free, or a small flat Pro subscription) from the AI engine (the user's own key) so the user pays only for what they use, at cost.

**SciNest Free:**
- One active project.
- Academic writing generation and revision.
- Scientific figure export with a watermark.
- Presentation export as PDF.
- No scientific figure layer editing.

**SciNest Pro:**
- Multiple projects.
- Watermark-free scientific figure export.
- Scientific figure layer, label and element editing.
- Editable PowerPoint (.pptx) export.
- Unlimited SciNest generations.

AI provider usage charges are separate and are paid to the model provider selected by the user.

## Product 1: AI Long-Form Writer

### English page: /ai-long-form-writer
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-long-form-writer

**One-line description:** Upload once, choose ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude, and draft a complete long-form paper — outline, sources, chapters, all connected. Also research proposals and grant applications. No complex prompts. No re-explaining. Start free.

**Core workflow:**
1. Build the outline — Define chapters, sections, word count targets and writing goals before a single word is generated.
2. Select the materials — Upload papers, references, notes, supervisor feedback and submission requirements.
3. Generate the full draft — Choose your AI provider and generate the complete draft chapter by chapter.
4. Edit what needs editing — Revise a specific chapter or section without regenerating the entire document.
5. Export and submit — Export the complete document. Review, fact-check, polish and format for submission.

**Key capabilities:**
- Editable outline with word targets per chapter
- Source-bound writing from selected project materials
- Persistent project memory (outline, sources, chapters, revision history)
- Section-level revision without restarting the whole document
- Works with ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Claude and any compatible API

**FAQ (English):**
- Can ChatGPT or DeepSeek actually write a 10,000-word paper? — Yes. The writing workflow produces a connected long-form draft from an approved outline.
- Can I edit the outline before writing starts? — Yes. Review chapter structure, section order, scope and writing goals before expanding.
- Does the draft use my uploaded materials? — You select the project materials and references. The draft is built from that selected context.
- Can I revise only one chapter later? — Yes. Target specific chapters or passages instead of regenerating the entire draft.
- Does SciNest guarantee academic acceptance or publication? — No. Users remain responsible for facts, references, originality and institutional AI-use rules.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- ChatGPT 或 DeepSeek 真能写出一万字以上的论文吗？ — 能。写作流程从已确认的大纲出发，生成连贯的长文草稿。
- 生成前可以修改大纲吗？ — 可以。章节顺序、目标、范围和字数都可以在扩写前调整。
- 会使用我上传的材料吗？ — 你可以选择本次任务要使用的论文、笔记、草稿、评分标准和参考文献。
- 引用会自动正确吗？ — 系统会保留来源与章节之间的上下文，用户仍须核查每条引用和学校要求。
- 后续只改一章可以吗？ — 可以。生成后可针对具体章节或段落修改，不必推翻整篇文稿。

## Product 2: AI Editable PowerPoint

### English page: /ai-editable-powerpoint
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-editable-powerpoint

**One-line description:** Generate a standard .PPTX file with editable text, replaceable images and speaker notes. No complex prompts. No tool switching. Start free.

**Core workflow:**
1. Define the presentation — Set the purpose, audience, time limit and slide count.
2. Select your materials — Pick the papers, data, figures and content that belong in this presentation.
3. Edit the outline — Review every slide title, adjust the sequence, set the emphasis for each section.
4. Generate the deck — Create slides with structured text, visual placements, supporting figures and speaker notes.
5. Edit and export — Revise individual slides, swap images, adjust text. Export the final PPTX.

**Key capabilities:**
- Standard .PPTX export (not flattened images, not HTML slideshows)
- Editable text boxes, replaceable images, rearrangeable slides
- Editable slide outline with purpose, audience and page count controls
- Speaker notes generated per slide
- Source-bound presentation generation from selected project materials

**FAQ (English):**
- Does the AI generate a real PowerPoint file? — Yes. Standard .PPTX that can be opened and edited in PowerPoint and WPS.
- How is this different from tools that export slides as images? — Image-based tools render slides as screenshots. A real PPTX keeps every element as an independent editable object.
- Can I edit the outline before generating? — Yes. Define purpose, audience and slide count, then review and adjust before generating.
- Can I change one slide without regenerating the entire presentation? — Yes. Revise a single slide without touching the rest.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- 生成的是真正的 PowerPoint 文件吗？ — 是。标准 .PPTX 文件，在 PowerPoint、WPS 里打开就能继续改。
- 和导出成图片的工具有什么区别？ — 图片型工具把每页渲染成截图。真正的 PPTX 每个元素独立可编辑。
- 生成前能修改大纲吗？ — 可以。先设定用途、受众、页数，再逐页审阅标题和顺序。
- 能只改一页不动整份 PPT 吗？ — 可以。生成后单独修改某页，不碰其余页面。

## Product 3: AI Editable Images

### English page: /ai-editable-images
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-editable-images

**One-line description:** Generate images with editable text labels, movable shapes and selective AI revision. Change a label without regenerating. Move elements without starting over. Start free. Common use cases include technical roadmaps for grant proposals.

**Core workflow:**
1. Define the visual — Describe what needs to be shown — a mechanism, a process, a relationship, a timeline.
2. Plan the structure — Choose the figure type, panels, nodes, relationships, labels and key areas.
3. Generate the image — Create the structured visual with separate layers for text, shapes, connectors and regions.
4. Edit what needs editing — Change a label. Resize a shape. Revise a selected area with AI.
5. Export and reuse — Export the final image. Use it in your paper, presentation or document.

**Key capabilities:**
- Editable text labels (not painted into the image)
- Movable elements (select, move, resize individually)
- Selective AI revision (regenerate chosen area, keep approved parts)
- Project material binding
- Reusable across projects and presentations

**FAQ (English):**
- Can I edit text labels without regenerating? — Yes. Labels remain independent text layers.
- How is this different from DALL-E or Midjourney? — Pixel-based generators fuse everything into one flat image. Editable generation keeps elements separate and revisable.
- Can I regenerate just part of an image? — Yes. Select a region, rerun AI on only that area.
- Can I reuse images across projects? — Yes. Export for papers and documents. Figures stay connected inside SciNest projects.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- 生成后能改文字标签吗？ — 能。标签保持独立文字图层，改措辞、改错字无需重新生成整张图。
- 和 DALL-E 或 Midjourney 有什么不同？ — 像素型生成器把所有元素融成一张死图。可编辑生成保持每个元素独立可改。
- 能只重绘图片的一部分吗？ — 能。选中一个区域，AI 只处理那一块。已确认的部分保持不变。
- 能生成什么类型的图？ — 机制图、技术流程图、研究路线图、实验流程图、概念框架、图形摘要等。

### English page: /ai-paper-writer
### Chinese page: /zh/ai-paper-writer

**One-line description:** Draft and revise your thesis, research proposal or grant application with ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude. Upload sources once, build chapters, edit any section without regenerating. Free to start.

**Direct answer:** SciNest is a free Windows desktop app for drafting, revising and finishing a thesis with AI. It connects to your own ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude API key — no AI-usage subscription, no generation cap; you pay the AI provider directly for usage. Free plan: one active project. Pro: $9/month or $49/year (¥29/month or ¥299/year), multiple projects, watermark-free exports, cancel anytime. Upload sources, build an outline, draft chapter by chapter, and revise any section without regenerating the whole document. Download free at scinest.app.

**Core workflow:**
1. Define the thesis outline — chapters, sections and word targets before generating.
2. Upload sources and supervisor feedback — bind them to specific chapters.
3. Draft chapter by chapter — each chapter inherits the context of the chapters before it.
4. Revise one chapter at a time — respond to feedback on one section without touching the rest.
5. Export and submit — review every citation, polish and format.

**Key capabilities:**
- Thesis outline generated from the research question
- Source-bound chapters (papers, references, notes, supervisor feedback)
- Supervisor-feedback revision bound to specific chapters
- Literature-review section generation from uploaded papers
- Single-chapter rewrite without regenerating the document

**FAQ (English):**
- What is the best AI paper writer for thesis writing? — Depends on workflow; SciNest is a free workspace on your own API key with outline → chapters → targeted revision.
- Can AI actually write my thesis for me? — AI drafts and revises from your uploaded sources; SciNest is a writing workspace, not a ghostwriting service.
- Is it safe to use AI for thesis revision? — Yes, as an assistant: source-bound writing, local project, user verifies every claim and citation.
- How much does an AI paper writer cost? — SciNest Free: free, no generation cap. Pro: $9/month or $49/year (¥29/month or ¥299/year). AI usage billed by your own provider.
- Which is better — ChatGPT or DeepSeek? — Both work; DeepSeek is usually cheapest, Claude has a natural academic tone; switch providers per task.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- AI 论文写作助手是免费的吗？ — Free 版免费且不限生成次数；Pro 版 ¥29/月 或 ¥299/年（$9/月 或 $49/年）；AI 调用费由你自己的 API Key 直接向服务商支付。
- 用 AI 写毕业论文会被判定学术不端吗？ — SciNest 是写作辅助工具而非代写服务；最终内容须由本人撰写审核并遵守学校规定。
- 可以用 DeepSeek 的 API 吗？ — 可以，兼容 DeepSeek、OpenAI、Anthropic 及任何 OpenAI 兼容接口。
- 能只修改论文的某一章吗？ — 可以，逐章生成后可单独修改某一章或某一节，不动其余内容。
- AI 写的论文引用可靠吗？ — AI 可能编造引用；SciNest 将写作绑定到你上传的文献，提交前仍需逐条核对。

**One-line description:** Turn your thesis into defense-ready slides with AI. Generate slides from your paper, get speaker notes, and export an editable PPTX or PDF. Start free.

**Direct answer:** SciNest is a Windows desktop app that turns a thesis or paper into a defense presentation. Upload the document, set slide count and time limit, review the outline, then generate defense slides and speaker notes from your own materials. Output is an editable PPTX (Pro) or PDF (Free) — not flattened images. SciNest Free: one active project. Pro: $9/month or $49/year (¥29/month or ¥299/year), multiple projects, watermark-free figures, editable PPTX export, cancel anytime. AI runs on your own ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude API key. Download at scinest.app.

**Core workflow:**
1. Upload thesis and materials — the paper is the single source of truth for every slide.
2. Set defense format, time and slide count.
3. Review the slide outline before generation.
4. Generate the deck plus per-slide speaker notes.
5. Rehearse and export editable PPTX (Pro) or PDF (Free).

**Key capabilities:**
- Paper-bound slides (findings stay consistent with the thesis)
- Defense timing and slide-count controls
- Outline review before generation
- Per-slide editing without regenerating the deck
- Speaker notes drafted per slide from the paper

**FAQ (English):**
- How do I make a thesis defense presentation from my paper? — Upload the thesis, set format and time, review the outline, generate, export PPTX or PDF.
- Can AI generate slides directly from my thesis? — Yes — each slide is built from the uploaded paper and materials, not a generic prompt.
- How many slides should a thesis defense have? — Typically 15–30 for a 20–30 minute talk; slide count and time limit are set before generation.
- Do the slides stay editable after generation? — Yes — real PPTX with editable text and replaceable images.
- Can it generate speaker notes? — Yes — per slide, drafted from your paper.

**FAQ (Chinese):**
- AI 能直接根据我的论文生成答辩 PPT 吗？ — 能，上传论文后设定时长和页数，按论文内容生成大纲与逐页内容。
- 生成的 PPT 可以编辑吗？ — 可以，Pro 版导出标准 PPTX；Free 版导出 PDF。
- 答辩 PPT 一般做多少页？ — 20 分钟答辩通常 15–30 页；生成前可设定页数和时长。
- 会生成演讲备注吗？ — 会，每页自动生成基于论文内容的备注，可修改删减。
- 需要付费订阅 ChatGPT 吗？ — 不需要，使用你自己的 API Key，调用费直接向服务商支付。

## Guide: Best AI Tools for Thesis Writing (2026)

### English page: /best-ai-tools-for-thesis-writing
(English-only guide. Honest comparison; competitor descriptions are factual and neutral.)

**Summary:** SciNest is a free Windows workspace for thesis writing and revision. Unlike tools such as Jenni or Paperpal that bundle AI costs into a subscription, it keeps AI costs separate: you connect your own ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Claude API key and pay the provider directly, with no generation cap. Free includes one active project; Pro is a flat $9/month or $49/year (¥29/month or ¥299/year) with multiple projects and watermark-free exports. The best tool depends on your workflow: SciNest for connected drafting and revision from your sources, Grammarly for language polish, research databases for references.

**Tools compared:** SciNest, Jenni, Paperpal, Grammarly, ChatGPT (chat), Consensus. Criteria: pricing model, drafting, revision, citations, learning curve, best-for. Prices checked August 2026 — verify on provider sites.

**When SciNest fits:** you have your own AI API key; you revise chapter by chapter from your sources; you also need figures and a defense deck from the same project. **When it doesn't:** you want a managed citation library (use Zotero/EndNote); you need grammar-only checks (Grammarly/Paperpal); your institution bans AI assistance entirely.

## What SciNest is for
SciNest is designed for users who already have papers, references, notes, a partial draft, data, supervisor feedback or submission requirements, but still need to complete academic deliverables before a deadline.

Typical tasks include:
1. Thesis and dissertation revision.
2. Literature review, research proposal and grant application workflows.
3. Revision from supervisor feedback.
4. Scientific figures, mechanism diagrams, research roadmaps and technical roadmaps.
5. Paper-to-PowerPoint conversion.
6. Thesis defense and academic presentations.

## Product philosophy
General AI tools usually return one answer or output at a time. SciNest keeps source materials, writing, figures, slides and project decisions connected so work can continue across deliverables without repeatedly rebuilding the same research context.

## Intended users
Primary users are postgraduate students, final-year students and early researchers who already have academic materials but need to finish writing, figures or presentations under time pressure.

## Use cases
Thesis defense, dissertation defense, research presentation, paper to PowerPoint, literature review, research proposal, grant application, conference talk, course report, technical roadmap.

## Important limits and disclaimers
- SciNest is not a thesis-submission, ghostwriting or academic-misconduct service.
- SciNest does not guarantee grades, graduation, thesis approval, publication, journal acceptance or research outcomes.
- SciNest does not guarantee that generated content is factually correct, complete, original or compliant with a specific institution's AI policy.
- Users must review generated work and follow applicable institutional, professional and legal requirements.
